lines.zh: : 但你当然能控制自己消费什么。这不是那种成瘾。这是很不一样的一种。对一个人的影响要隐晦得多。

lines.en: : So tell me, when you’re sitting there at your computer or lying in your bed, stroking yourself to fantasies about my little girl, which part of the daydream do you normally cum for? Seriously. I want to know.
lines.zh: : 那么告诉我，当你坐在电脑前、或者躺在床上，靠着对我家小姑娘的幻想套弄自己的时候，你通常是为白日梦里的哪一段射的？说真的。我想知道。

lines.en: : I don’t...that’s not...
lines.zh: : 我没有……不是那样……

lines.en: : Akira, I am a single mother with one daughter. She is the only thing tethering me to this world at the moment. So I need you to be straight with me when I ask you this.
lines.zh: : Akira，我是个单亲母亲，只有一个女儿。眼下她是唯一把我拴在这个世界上的东西。所以我问你这件事的时候，你得跟我说实话。

lines.en: : Are you or are you not having sex with her? Because if you’re not, someone else is. Which gives me the interesting and unwanted opportunity of figuring out which of those outcomes is worse.
lines.zh: : 你到底有没有和她上床？因为如果不是你，那就是别人。而这给了我一个有趣却并不想要的机会——去搞清楚这两种结果哪个更糟。

lines.en: scene makiporntalk24
: What could be worse than that?...
lines.zh: : 还有什么能比那更糟？……

lines.en: : Well, they say knowing is half the battle, don’t they? Maybe that somehow applies here? It’s been a while since I’ve dealt with any predators, in all fairness. Or at least I’d like to think so.
lines.zh: : 嗯，人家说「知道就是胜利的一半」，不是吗？也许在这儿也适用？说句公道话，我已经很久没跟捕食者打过交道了。至少我愿意这么想。

lines.en: : Especially since you have been preyed upon. You should know how big this is. You should know better.
lines.zh: : 尤其是你自己也被捕食过。你应该知道这事有多大。你应该更明白才对。

lines.en: : But I...I never...said anything...I haven’t agreed. You just decided I did this.
lines.zh: : 但是我……我从来……什么都没说过……我没有承认。是你自己认定我做了。

lines.en: : If it makes you feel any better, I decided you didn’t well before that. That’s on me, though. And I will have to live with that forever, amongst other things.
lines.zh: : 如果这能让你好受些的话——在那之前很久，我就认定了你没做。不过那是我的问题。而我将不得不带着它活一辈子，连同其他那些事一起。

lines.en: : Just like you will have to live with what that evil woman did to you. And how Makoto will have to live with what you...allegedly...have done to her.
lines.zh: : 就像你也得带着那个邪恶的女人对你做的事活下去。而 Makoto 也得带着你……据称……对她做过的事活下去。

lines.en: : She’s mature for her age, isn’t she? Brilliant. Creative. Hard to say “no” to. You can use that as an excuse if it makes it easier to come clean.
lines.zh: : 以她的年纪来说，她很成熟，对吧？聪明。有创造力。很难对她说「不」。要是拿这个当借口能让你更容易坦白，尽管用。
